reviewer: BPM 0.9.5.1 product-documentation editorial and PDF release review

topic_authority_review.coverage_rule: The BPM095-M8-01 impact inventory was reviewed against all four affected guide maps. Every reader-visible lifecycle, conversion, support-boundary, recovery, and API change has one audience owner; Firefox and CIS changes are also covered by the User Guide's referenced workflows rather than by an invented standalone PDF.

editorial_review.english_style: Reviewed affected English headings, procedures, expected results, warnings, recovery copy, API explanations, and support boundaries for concise Microsoft-style reader language and one-action procedural steps.
editorial_review.completeness_and_exclusions: Reviewed ESR 115 purpose/caveat, four-channel choice, latest-ESR recommendation, manual preview/apply, failure recovery, policy availability, CIS channel availability, API envelopes, and retirement recovery. No maintainer workflow, CI instruction, raw internal recipe, secret, private host, or future capability is presented as reader-visible behavior.
editorial_review.bpm_ui_and_mozilla_terminology: BPM UI labels are checked against app/i18n locale catalogs. Firefox UI and support-prose evidence follows documentation/config/locale-terminology-authority-0.9.1.json: Mozilla Pontoon lookup template https://pontoon.mozilla.org/{locale}/firefox/all-resources/?search={source_term}; Mozilla SUMO lookup template https://support.mozilla.org/{locale}/kb/{article_slug}.
editorial_review.dita_and_site_ownership: DITA source remains the only hand-authored input. documentation/tools/build_docs.py and documentation/buildlib own the regenerated HTML site, navigation, search, PDF candidate, and manifests; no generated output was hand-edited.

screenshot_review.reason: The approved matrix contains no pre-authorized conversion-review scenario. The feature changes text and workflows, not an approved screenshot state or its printable geometry; adding a conversion screenshot would require explicit backlog approval and six-locale caption/alt-text ownership.
screenshot_review.pdf_spotcheck: A reused User Guide figure was visually inspected at printable scale. Its localized caption, image bounds, readable UI, and adjacent numbered procedure fit without clipping.

pdf_scope.exclusion_reason: The maintained PDF generation contract has exactly User and Administrator source maps. Firefox Policy and CIS are affected and were reviewed in DITA/site and as referenced User Guide workflows, but no separate Firefox or CIS PDF artifact exists in the delivery contract.
